purpose: Source-level reference matrix for the thirteen strict external island-system challenges used in the simulation manuscript. Citations support observed state assignment only; they do not calibrate ABM parameters or identify a shared empirical mechanism.

primary_references.citation: Hiraiwa and Ushimaru 2024 functional plant-pollinator network study
Hiraiwa and Ushimaru 2017 reproductive-sensitivity study

systems.observed_state_basis: independent datasets repeatedly reject a uniform downstream plant-response syndrome: shared corrected-matching decline coexists with divergent tube, pollen-receipt and reproductive response modes
systems.claim_boundary: cross-study response heterogeneity, not same-estimand replication or a single causal coefficient

primary_references.citation: Watanabe et al. 2018, Plant Species Biology 33:16-27
Watanabe and Sugawara 2015, AoB PLANTS
Watanabe et al. 2014, Flora

systems.observed_state_basis: introduced honeybee-dominated access asymmetry -> directional pollen transfer -> strong floral-morph fruit-set asymmetry
systems.claim_boundary: qualitative physical-access propagation; not randomized historical pollinator replacement and not a source-native numeric signed-position test

primary_references.citation: Case et al. 2026, Functional Ecology, Bird extinctions shift bill-flower trait matching in Hawaiian lobelioids
Case et al. 2026, Ecology and Evolution, Mutualism and Antagonism in a Post-Extinction Hawaiian Bird-Lobelioid Pollination System

systems.observed_state_basis: post-extinction signed interaction mismatch and frequent robbing/resource change coexist with high reproductive performance
systems.claim_boundary: cross-study buffering boundary; no same-tagged full causal chain and no identified empirical ABM buffer mechanism

primary_references.citation: Temeles et al. 2013, Journal of Evolutionary Biology
Marten-Rodriguez et al. 2011, Oecologia

systems.observed_state_basis: frozen negative signed-position prediction failed: the primary cross-unit selection slope was positive and declared sensitivities did not rescue the predicted direction
systems.claim_boundary: failure retained; mapping is not retuned and does not falsify the synthetic v12 branch-generator result

primary_references.citation: Schueller 2004, American Journal of Botany, Self-pollination in island and mainland populations of Nicotiana glauca
Schueller 2007, Evolutionary Ecology, Island-mainland difference in Nicotiana glauca corolla length

systems.observed_state_basis: higher island autonomous selfing capacity and corolla differences occur without a detected current island pollinator-service deficit
systems.claim_boundary: supports buffering/establishment alternative state, not historical pollinator-mediated causation or a complete matched causal bridge

primary_references.citation: Fumero-Caban, Melendez-Ackerman and Rojas-Sandoval 2022, Journal of Pollination Ecology 32:139-153

systems.observed_state_basis: large visitor-assemblage and visitation contrast coexists with similar self/outcross seed-set index, while other realized reproductive axes differ
systems.claim_boundary: axis-decoupling constraint; must not be collapsed into a whole-reproduction buffering label

primary_references.citation: Marten-Rodriguez et al. 2015, Journal of Ecology, A comparison of reproductive strategies between island and mainland Caribbean Gesneriaceae
Marten-Rodriguez and Fenster 2010, Ecology, Pollen limitation and reproductive assurance in Antillean Gesnerieae
Marten-Rodriguez et al. 2010, New Phytologist, Evolutionary breakdown of pollination specialization in a Caribbean plant radiation

systems.observed_state_basis: lower island hummingbird visitation is associated with lineage-specific generalization, pollination-system transitions and reproductive-assurance alternatives rather than one universal autofertility response
systems.claim_boundary: clade-level cross-study branching recurrence; not a matched population-level causal chain and no visit-level effectiveness bridge

systems.display_name: New Zealand Rhabdothamnus solandri bird-pollination natural experiment

primary_references.citation: Anderson et al. 2011, Science, Cascading effects of bird functional extinction reduce pollination and plant density

systems.observed_state_basis: native bird functional loss -> stronger pollen limitation -> lower seed production -> lower recruitment/density
systems.claim_boundary: strong qualitative propagation natural experiment; not a numerical fit of the ABM trait-position mechanism

primary_references.citation: Mortensen, Dupont and Olesen 2008, Biological Conservation 141:2146-2154, A snake in paradise

systems.observed_state_basis: bird extirpation -> zero bird visitation on Guam -> lower seed set in two native plants -> lower Bruguiera recruitment
systems.claim_boundary: qualitative propagation under a particular snake-driven bird-extirpation natural experiment; not a universal island-isolation mechanism

primary_references.citation: Global Ecology and Conservation 42 (2023) e02413, Impacts of invasive ants on pollination of native plants are similar in invaded and restored plant communities

systems.observed_state_basis: invasive-ant presence -> reduced flowers probed per visit -> reduced native plant reproduction
systems.claim_boundary: within-island experimental/context propagation test; not a unique ABM mechanism or universal restoration effect

primary_references.citation: Hansen and Muller 2009, Biotropica 41:202-208, Invasive Ants Disrupt Gecko Pollination and Seed Dispersal of the Endangered Plant Roussea simplex in Mauritius

systems.observed_state_basis: invasive-ant interference -> reduced gecko access/visitation -> reduced seed set
systems.claim_boundary: within-island experimental propagation; not the ABM trait-position mechanism and not a universal invasive-ant effect

systems.display_name: Canary Islands Teide managed-honeybee network experiment

primary_references.citation: Valido, Rodriguez-Rodriguez and Jordano 2019, Scientific Reports 9:4711, Honeybees disrupt the structure and functionality of plant-pollinator networks

systems.observed_state_basis: common managed-honeybee/network perturbation -> plant-specific interaction exposure -> divergent seed-output responses among five focal plant species
systems.claim_boundary: multi-plant branching state; reproductive axes remain distinct and the honeybee mechanism is not transported to other island systems

systems.display_name: Bahamas Pavonia bahamensis hurricane pollination natural experiment

primary_references.citation: Rathcke 2000, Ecology 81:1951-1958, Hurricane causes resource and pollination limitation of fruit set in a bird-pollinated shrub

systems.observed_state_basis: hurricane-driven bird-pollinator decline -> loss of pollen receipt -> additional pollination limitation -> fruit-set collapse
systems.claim_boundary: the source separately identified direct resource limitation; the strict propagation claim concerns the additional pollination-limitation component

manuscript_boundary: These references support the source-locked observed-state assignments. They must not be used to imply that qualitative state compatibility identifies the ABM mechanism operating in a real system.
